ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (23) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Attributions follow the print: «Кошут» (Koshut) is the surname only, 'Kossuth', not the website draft's 'Lajos Kossuth'. In the Kant passage «дать себя убедить» (dat' sebya ubedit', 'to let oneself be convinced') is set against «убедиться самому» (ubedit'sya samomu, 'to become convinced by oneself') as in the Russian.
